description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of the Land in Balapitiya D/S Division, Galle District
reasoning: This gazette content is a notice under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act concerning the deposit of compensation for the acquisition of a specific land parcel. It provides detailed information about the land, including its name, plan number, lot number, extent, and boundaries. The primary subject matter is the compulsory acquisition of land and the associated compensation process, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category for land and property-related matters.
